name: Krog Street Tunnel
address: Krog St NE at Wylie St SE, Atlanta, GA 30307
lightingNotes: shaded inside; the cleanest light is at the two openings.
accessNotes: Public underpass with car and foot traffic. Bring a spotter.

name: Jackson Street Bridge
address: Jackson St NE at Irwin St NE, Atlanta, GA 30312
lightingNotes: skyline faces west, so sunset backlights the city.
accessNotes: Narrow public sidewalk that gets crowded at sunset.

name: Historic Fourth Ward Park
lightingNotes: pond and lawn give soft, even light in the evening.
accessNotes: City park. Check whether paid shoots need a permit.

name: Piedmont Park
lightingNotes: open meadow with a skyline view; little shade at midday.
accessNotes: Piedmont Park Conservancy has rules for commercial photography.

name: Ponce City Market (exterior)
address: 675 Ponce de Leon Ave NE, Atlanta, GA 30308
lightingNotes: brick facade glows warm late in the day.
accessNotes: Private property. Ask management before any paid shoot.

name: BeltLine Eastside Trail
address: pick one stretch, e.g. Eastside Trail near Irwin St NE, Atlanta, GA 30312
lightingNotes: tree-lined path with dappled light; check the open stretches at golden hour.
accessNotes: Public trail with heavy foot and bike traffic. Check the BeltLine's rules for commercial photography.

name: Atlanta Botanical Garden
lightingNotes: dappled shade most of the day; check golden hour on the open lawns.
accessNotes: Paid admission and a commercial photography permit are likely required.

name: Castleberry Hill Arts District
address: pick one block, e.g. Peters St SW near Walker St SW, Atlanta, GA 30313
lightingNotes: brick warehouses with narrow streets; check where the sun hits at your shoot time.
accessNotes: Public streets. Watch for traffic; some walls are private.

name: Politan Row at Colony Square (interior)
address: 1197 Peachtree St NE, Suite 150, Atlanta, GA 30361
lightingNotes: Indoor food hall. Check available window light and interior lighting at your shoot time.
accessNotes: Opens at 11am according to the venue. Contact management to arrange permission for a professional shoot.

name: Hyatt Regency Atlanta Atrium
lightingNotes: tall atrium with soft overhead light and warm interior lighting.
accessNotes: Private hotel lobby. Ask the hotel before any paid shoot.

name: Atlanta-Fulton Central Library
address: 1 Margaret Mitchell Sq NW, Atlanta, GA 30303
lightingNotes: concrete interior with strong geometric shadows from the windows.
accessNotes: Public building. Ask the library about photography policy and permits.

name: Fox Theatre (lobby and interior)
lightingNotes: dim, ornate interior; plan for low-light settings.
accessNotes: Private venue. Access is by tour or booking, so ask about photo permission.

name: Ponce City Market (Rooftop)
address: 675 Ponce de Leon Ave NE, Atlanta, GA 30308
lightingNotes: Open-air rooftop with skyline views. Plan around daylight and weather; scout the light at your shoot time.
accessNotes: Ticketed rooftop. Professional photoshoots, promotional content, and cameras with extra gear require advance approval from The Roof Events team; call 770-999-1530.

name: Westside Provisions District
address: 1198 Howell Mill Rd NW, Atlanta, GA 30318
lightingNotes: converted-industrial streets with string lights; good at dusk.
accessNotes: Private development. Ask management before any paid shoot.

name: Sweet Auburn Murals
address: pick one mural wall, e.g. along Auburn Ave NE, Atlanta, GA 30303
lightingNotes: depends on wall orientation; check the time of day for each mural.
accessNotes: Public sidewalks, but some murals are on private walls. Respect the artists.
